_readme: Files still resolving ~/.patchwork by hand instead of patchworkPath() (#1265).
This is a RATCHET, not an approval list. Every entry is a known bug: setting
PATCHWORK_HOME relocates some state and not the state named here, producing a
split installation with no error. The gate exists so the count can only go
DOWN — a new file resolving the path by hand fails CI.
To fix one: replace path.join(os.homedir(), ".patchwork") with patchworkPath()
and DELETE its line here. Do not add entries.
Converted 2026-08-10: src/bridge.ts and src/tools/index.ts ledger roots — the
four audit ledgers, where evidence silently landing elsewhere is the worst

2026-08-14 batch 2 (#1265): recipes/orchestration paths converted (31 -> 25). inboxRoutes.ts and recipes/yamlRunner.ts were converted and then DELIBERATELY REVERTED: the inbox is written via `~` expansion / os.homedir() in bridge.ts and yamlRunner.ts, so converting only the reader (or only the containment check) makes reader and writer resolve to different directories whenever PATCHWORK_HOME is set — the exact split this issue is about, moved rather than fixed. Converting them needs `~` expansion to route through the same helper, which changes where recipe file writes LAND, and that belongs in its own change.
